title: Connectors
$comment: Assembly connectors, each joining one component's `provide` port to another component's `require` port over a compatible interface.

name.description: The connector's identity; the file is named from it (`connectors/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the layer, must not be empty, and immutable.

from.description: The providing endpoint: the component and the `provide` port the connector starts from. Its port's interface must satisfy the `to` port's, which the same interface always does.

to.description: The requiring endpoint: the component and the `require` port the connector delivers to. Its port's interface must be satisfied by the `from` port's, which the same interface always does.

composition.description: The name of the declared composition this connector belongs to. Absent means the root composition: the root's name is a property of the model rather than a constant, so it is resolved where the model is in hand — in the writer, in the rules and in the importer — and never written into the file as a default.

description.description: Free text about the connector. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

connector_endpoint.description: One end of an assembly connector: the component or composition type that owns the port, and the port. A nested object rather than a list member, so it has no identity of its own and every field of it may change. It names the TYPE either way; the writer resolves that type to the member of it inside the connector's own composition, which is why a type may stand only once per composition.

swc.description: The name of the declared software component that owns the endpoint's port. Exactly one of `swc` and `composition` is set; this one is the endpoint of an ordinary component.

composition.description: The name of the declared composition that owns the endpoint's port, where the endpoint is a sub-composition's boundary port. Exactly one of `swc` and `composition` is set; an endpoint declaring neither, or both, is refused.

port.description: The name of a port of that component. Must not be empty; the port's existence and its direction are checked against the component.
